# Studio Form — Custom Enterprise AI & Voice Agent Company

Studio Form is a premier enterprise artificial intelligence engineering company based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. We design, build, and deploy custom agentic solutions: autonomous multilingual voice agents, domain-specific fine-tuned LLMs, zero-hallucination Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and custom workflow automations.

## Verified Statistics
- **Active Pilots**: 15+ custom enterprise pilot projects deployed.
- **Voice Agent Pilots**: 5 active conversational telephony systems.
- **Domain Models**: 4 fine-tuned industry LLMs (Aviation, Healthcare, Legal, Finance).
- **Languages Support**: 3 active languages (English, Hindi, Marathi) with regional Indic dialects code-mixing.
- **Uptime Commitment**: SLA-backed target.
- **Turn-taking Latency**: Low latency (optimized for sub-800ms response).

## Core Offerings
- [Voice Agents](https://studioform.app/services/voice-agents): Telephony integrations (Twilio, SIP, Exotel) supporting bilinguality and real-time dialogue state management.
- [RAG Chatbots](https://studioform.app/services/rag-chatbots): Multimodal layout-aware parsing pipeline extracting tables, headers, and footnotes with page-level citations.
- [Domain LLMs](https://studioform.app/services/llm-development): isolated VPC fine-tuning under India's DPDP Act of 2023.
- [AI Automation](https://studioform.app/services/ai-automation): Custom agentic loops connecting CRM, ERP, and API endpoints (Make, n8n, Node/Python).
- [Claude Skills](https://studioform.app/services/custom-ai): Enterprise custom tool-packs for Anthropic Claude.
- [AI Workshops](https://studioform.app/workshops): Engineer-led, hands-on ML upskilling programs.
- [AI University](https://studioform.app/ai-university): Labs and bootcamps for colleges and schools.

## Pricing & Engagement
- [Pricing Model](https://studioform.app/pricing): Transparent platform customization pricing starting at $1,000/mo (custom pilot) up to custom Enterprise VPC plans.
